about: Discover cards and the Verse of the Day rotation. Only references and reflection questions live here: verse text always comes from the translations in the database. Reflections are short prompts, kept separate from Scripture. The first card of each theme is from the design kit (specs/content-fixtures.json); the rest are drafts for the owner to review. Checked by scripts/check-content.mjs.
